record.question: What is the primary purpose of a voiding cystourethrogram (VCUG)?
options: To image the bladder and urethra during urination.
To detect kidney stones without contrast.
record.explanation: Answer B: To image the bladder and urethra during urination.. VCUG uses fluoroscopy to image the bladder/lower urinary tract as the bladder fills and empties. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/safety-xray. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
